item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Metrics API graduates to stable
item.description: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the metrics.k8s.io API to stable ( v1 ). This API provides CPU and memory usage for nodes and Pods, and is the API behind commands such as kubectl top and resource-metrics-based autoscaling. (1 source: kubernetesblog)

item.title: Relaunching HashiCorp Validated Designs with improved usability
item.description: Learn how the refreshed HashiCorp Validated Designs help teams find field-tested guidance for deploying, operating, and using products in production. (1 source: hashicorp)
